name: mobile-boilerplate
description: Monorepo boilerplate: Flutter mobile + NestJS API + shared OpenAPI Dart client

scripts.install:melos: command -v melos >/dev/null || (command -v fvm >/dev/null && fvm dart pub global activate melos) || dart pub global activate melos
scripts.bootstrap:full: pnpm install && pnpm install:melos && pnpm codegen:api && melos bootstrap
scripts.test:cov: pnpm --filter @mobile-boilerplate/api test:cov && (cd apps/mobile && fvm flutter test --coverage)
